candidate_relations.reason: Osteosarcoma requires malignant osteoid production, which is not described; the spindle-cell tumor with Bcl-2, EMA, CD99, and TLE-1 positivity supports synovial sarcoma instead.
Although PNET may express CD99, the spindle-cell morphology and combined Bcl-2, EMA, and TLE-1 positivity are characteristic of synovial sarcoma; synaptophysin negativity also does not support PNET.
The candidate provides no diagnosis and therefore does not match the benchmark diagnosis of synovial sarcoma.
